name: Shatter / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A broad explosive ice-smashing crash and crunchy frozen collapse, followed by a dense sustained cascade of sharp glassy chunks, scattered icy ticks and a falling crystalline tail. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
